data.name: Maleekah
data.gender_notes: Maleekah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'malakah' meaning 'lordship, sovereignty, or possession'. In Islamic context, it signifies being in God's possession and being devoted to Him. The name Maleekah carries the meaning “God's Possession” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maleekah usually hope their child will grow to embody god's possession and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be a humble servant of God, carrying out His will.
data.etymology: Maleekah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Possession.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maleekah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: ملكah
in_arabic.meaning: ملكah تعني الملكة أو الحاكمة في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: ملكah هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة 'ملك' التي تعني الحكم أو الملكية. يعني الاسم الملكة أو الحاكمة، وغالبًا ما يرتبط بالصفات الإلهية في القرآن الكريم. في التاريخ الإسلامي، استخدم الاسم لوصف النساء ذوات الم地位 الرفيع في المجتمع، مثل الملكات أو الأميرات. يعتبر اسم ملكah ذو أهمية روحية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يرمز إلى القوة والسلطة والقيادة.

in_urdu.name: ملکہ
in_urdu.meaning: ملکہ کا مطلب ہے شاہی خاندان کی خاتون یا حکمرانی کرنے والی
in_urdu.long_meaning: ملکہ ایک عربی मूल کا اسم علم مؤنث ہے، جو 'ملك' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے حکمرانی یا ریاست۔ یہ نام شاہی خاندان کی خاتون، شہزادی یا ملکہ کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام اعلیٰ مقام رکھنے والی خواتین کے لئے استعمال کیا گیا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے کہ وہ شخصیت جو اقتدار، حکمت، اور رہبری کی صفات کو اپنے اندر سموئے ہوئے ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मलिकाह
in_hindi.meaning: मलिकाह का अर्थ है शाही परिवार की महिला या शासक
in_hindi.long_meaning: मलिकाह एक अरबी मूल का स्त्रीलिंग नाम है, जो 'मलिक' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है शासन करना या राज्य। यह नाम शाही परिवार की महिला, राजकुमारी या रानी के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम उच्च पदस्थ महिलाओं के लिए उपयोग किया गया है। इसका अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो शक्ति, ज्ञान और नेतृत्व के गुणों को अपने अंदर समेटे हुए है।

in_pashto.name: ملکه
in_pashto.meaning: ملکه د يوې ملکې يا واکمنې ښځې معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: ملکه د عربي اصل يو ښځينه نوم دی، چې د 'ملك' څخه اخيستل شوی دی، کوم چې د واکمنۍ يا پاچاهۍ معنی لري. دا نوم د پاچاهۍ د کورنۍ ښځې، شهزادۍ يا ملکہ لپاره کارول کيږي. په اسلامي دود کې، دا نوم د لوړ پوړو ښځو لپاره کارول شوی دی. دا د هغه چا معنی لري چې قدرت، حکمت، او مشرتوب ځانګړتیاوې لري.

in_english.name: Maleekah
in_english.meaning: Means queen or ruler, derived from Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: Maleekah is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the word 'malik,' meaning king or ruler. It signifies a queen, princess, or a woman of high authority. In Islamic tradition, the name is associated with divine attributes and is used to describe women of noble and high social status. The name embodies qualities of power, wisdom, and leadership, reflecting its rich etymological and cultural significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Maleekah" signifies strong Islamic beliefs and values. In the Islamic culture, naming a child with this name conveys an inherent message of faith and devotion to Allah, as "maleek" translates to 'master, owner, or ruler'. It is a name that signifies submission, obedience, and loyalty, all of which are essential qualities for Muslims to have towards their Creator.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Maleekah" holds deep spiritual significance in Islam. It signifies a close and personal relationship with Allah, emphasizing His sovereignty over everyone's lives and possessions. The name serves as a constant reminder of the Divine Ownership, and the importance of remaining in Allah's presence and following His guidance at all times. It also reflects the belief that true happiness and satisfaction come from being in alignment with Allah's will.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Hazm records the name Maleekah as one of the wives of Caliph Umar ibn Al-Khattab. She was known for her generosity and kindness towards the poor.

Al-Baladhuri mentions Maleekah bint Dinar as a wealthy woman who, during the siege of Damascus during the early Umayyad Caliphate, entertained the besieged Umayyad governor and provided him with valuable information, which led to the relief of the city.
